domains.blurb_zh: 营销站、落地页、作品集的画廊与模式库
domains.blurb_en: Galleries and pattern collections for marketing sites, landing pages, portfolios, stores and their sections. Galleries show what designers admire, not what converts or what users can use: pair one gallery with a real-product or evidence source.

sections.note_zh: 看整体美术指导。打开真实网站看——缩略图藏起了字体渲染、动效和响应式。
sections.note_en: For overall art direction. Open the live site - thumbnails hide type rendering, motion and responsiveness.

sections.zh: 落地页与 SaaS 官网
sections.note_zh: 看页面叙事与版块顺序：整页截图展示论证是如何排布的。
sections.note_en: For page narrative and section order. Full-page captures show how the argument is sequenced.

sections.note_zh: 问题具体到某个版块（Hero、导航、定价、页脚）时来这，一次比较十个解法。
sections.note_en: When the question is one section (hero, nav, pricing, footer, CTA, email). Compare ten solutions to the same problem.

sections.note_zh: 暗色、粗野主义、电商、作品集与日韩画廊——后者是中日韩排版最好的公开参考。
sections.note_en: Dark mode, brutalist, e-commerce, portfolios, and Japanese and Korean galleries - the best public references for CJK typographic layout.

sections.note_zh: 野心、动效与 WebGL。评审奖励奇观，不评审可用性和转化。
sections.note_en: Ambition, motion and WebGL. Juries reward spectacle; usability and conversion are not judged.

sections.note_zh: 要说服人的页面，结构与文案的证据在这里。
sections.note_en: Structure and messaging evidence for pages that must persuade.

domains.blurb_zh: 真实产品的界面、官方平台规范、公开的设计系统
domains.blurb_en: What actually ships: screens and flows from real products, component references, official platform guidelines and published design systems. Prefer these over concept shots for anything users will operate daily.

sections.note_zh: 设计某种页面或流程前，先看几个已上线产品怎么做。惯例本身就是功能。
sections.note_en: Look up the screen type or flow in several shipped products before designing it. Convention is a feature.

sections.note_zh: 组件的结构、命名、状态与键盘行为，跨系统对照。
sections.note_en: Anatomy, naming, states and keyboard behaviour of a component across systems.

sections.note_zh: 权威且带版本。引用记忆中的数字前，先看当前页面。
sections.note_en: Authoritative and versioned. Check the current page before relying on a remembered number.

sections.note_zh: 读它的模式与内容指引，不只读组件；挑一个领域相近的系统。
sections.note_en: Read the pattern and content guidance, not just the components. Pick a system from a comparable domain.

sections.note_zh: 游戏 HUD、虚构界面与小惊喜——为沉浸式和"一个记忆点"的问题准备。
sections.note_en: Game HUDs, fictional interfaces and small delights - for immersive, full-screen and one-memorable-moment problems.

domains.blurb_zh: 从问题选图表、让图表诚实易读的指引、画图的库、仪表盘与大屏参考，以及为数据设计的色板
domains.blurb_en: One home for everything chart-shaped: choosing the chart from the question, the guides that keep charts honest and readable, the libraries that draw them, dashboard and big-screen references, and palettes built for data.

sections.note_zh: 先定图表要回答的问题（比较、排名、占比、随时间变化），再按一份风格指南处理坐标轴、标注和颜色。
sections.note_en: Start from the question the chart answers (compare, rank, part-to-whole, change over time), then follow one style guide for axes, labels and colour.

sections.note_zh: 按技术栈和图表复杂度选库；商用前查授权，API 以已安装的版本为准。
sections.note_en: Match the library to the stack and the chart's complexity; check commercial licences and verify APIs against the installed version.

sections.note_zh: 排版前先研究门类：运维看板、分析报表和数据大屏在信息密度、刷新方式和观看距离上的规则各不相同。
sections.note_en: Study the genre before laying one out: operational dashboards, analytical reports and big-screen data walls differ in density, refresh and viewing distance.

sections.note_zh: 已发表的优秀可视化：学叙事、标注和克制。
sections.note_en: Published visualisations to learn narrative, annotation and restraint from.

sections.note_zh: 顺序、发散与分类色板，在色觉障碍下也要可区分；放进真实图表里测试。
sections.note_en: Sequential, diverging and categorical schemes that stay distinct under colour-vision deficiency. Test them in real chart types.

domains.blurb_zh: AI 产品的交互模式与指引、生成界面与素材的工具，以及面向 agent 的 skill、格式与 MCP；领域变化快，取用要标注日期
domains.blurb_en: Designing AI products (interaction patterns, platform guidance), AI tools that generate interfaces and assets, and the agent-facing layer: skills, rule sets, formats such as DESIGN.md, and MCP servers that give agents design files and a browser. This field moves quickly: date what you take.

sections.note_zh: 来自已上线产品的对话、副驾驶与 agent 界面模式，以及实现这些模式的组件套件。
sections.note_en: Chat, copilot and agent interface patterns from shipped products, plus the component kits that implement them.

sections.note_zh: 关于信任、可解释性、AI 内容标识以及对话宿主内界面的官方与研究型指引；每一页都要看日期。
sections.note_en: Official and research-based guidance on trust, explainability, labelling AI output and UI inside chat hosts. Check the date on every page.

sections.zh: AI 设计工具与生成器
sections.note_zh: 从提示词生成界面或素材的工具：适合快速出变体，也用来看清当下 AI 的“默认长相”——那正是要避开的样子。
sections.note_en: Prompt-to-UI and prompt-to-asset tools. Useful for fast variants and for seeing the current default look, which is also the look to diverge from.

sections.note_zh: 本套件的先行者：引导 coding agent 做出更好界面的 skill 与规则清单。取其思路；它们互相竞争、互有重叠。
sections.note_en: Prior art for this suite: skills and rule lists that steer coding agents toward better interfaces. Read them for ideas; they compete and overlap.

sections.note_zh: 向 agent 描述设计系统的文件格式（如 DESIGN.md）及其合集。
sections.note_en: Files that describe a design system to an agent, such as DESIGN.md, and collections of them.

sections.zh: 设计相关 MCP 服务
sections.note_zh: 给 agent 设计文件、组件注册表，以及用来截图和检查的真实浏览器。
sections.note_en: MCP servers that give an agent design files, component registries and a real browser for screenshots and checks.

domains.blurb_zh: 适用的标准与法规、检测工具、天生无障碍的组件模式，以及合规之外的包容性设计（含适老化）
domains.blurb_en: The standards and laws that apply, tools that test a build, patterns that are accessible by construction, and inclusive design beyond compliance, including age-friendly design. Automated checks catch only part of the issues: keep a manual keyboard and screen-reader pass.

sections.note_zh: WCAG 2.2 是工作基线；各地法规（欧盟 EAA 与 EN 301 549、美国 ADA 与 508、中国 GB/T 37668 与适老化规范）决定哪里必须做到什么。引用具体的成功准则，不要转述。
sections.note_en: WCAG 2.2 is the working baseline; laws (EU EAA and EN 301 549, US ADA and Section 508, China GB/T 37668 and the age-friendly rules) decide what is required where. Cite the success criterion, not a paraphrase.

sections.note_zh: 自动检测、浏览器扩展与对比度工具。自动与手动各做一遍；自动报告全绿不等于可访问。
sections.note_en: Automated checkers, browser extensions and contrast tools. Run one automated and one manual pass; a clean automated report is not proof of access.

sections.note_zh: 键盘行为、ARIA 角色与可访问的组件模式，以及通俗的检查清单。
sections.note_en: Keyboard behaviour, ARIA roles and accessible component patterns, plus plain-language checklists.

sections.note_zh: 为永久、暂时与情境性障碍、老年用户和低识读能力的人设计，而不只是通过一张清单。
sections.note_en: Designing for permanent, temporary and situational disability, older users and low literacy, beyond passing a checklist.

domains.blurb_zh: 上线产品的动效实录、曲线与弹簧工具、官方指引
domains.blurb_en: Recordings of motion in shipped products are the best teacher: watch them slowed down and note duration, easing, origin and what does not move. Then tools to author curves and springs, official guidelines, and the few writers worth reading.

sections.note_zh: 任何产品内动效从这里开始：慢放，记下时长、曲线、起点和什么没动。
sections.note_en: Start here for any in-product animation.

sections.zh: 网页动效秀场与素材库
sections.en: Web motion showcases and asset libraries
sections.note_zh: 表现性与实验性作品，通常带源码；素材注意授权。
sections.note_en: Expressive and experimental work, usually with source. Check licences on assets.

sections.note_zh: 凭手感调曲线和弹簧，然后把数值记成 token。
sections.note_en: Author curves and springs by eye, then record the numbers as tokens.

sections.zh: 官方动效指引与无障碍
sections.note_zh: token 表、原则，以及动效敏感的规则。
sections.note_en: Token tables, principles, and the rules for motion sensitivity.

sections.en: Writing and courses on motion craft
sections.note_zh: 少量但值得通读的读物。
sections.note_en: A small set that repays reading in full.

sections.note_zh: SwiftUI、Compose、Flutter 的 API 与示例集。
sections.note_en: API references and example collections for SwiftUI, Compose and Flutter.

domains.blurb_zh: 图标家族、搜索与 API、品牌 logo、绘制指引
domains.blurb_en: Pick one family per product and record its licence. Raw-SVG endpoints are listed so an agent can pull an icon without installing a package.

sections.note_zh: 按风格匹配、覆盖量、字重、平台封装、授权与维护度来选。
sections.note_en: Choose by style fit, coverage, weights, platform packages, licence and maintenance.

sections.note_zh: 跨图标集查概念的地方；结果不要混用在同一界面里。
sections.note_en: For finding a concept across sets. Do not mix the results in one interface.

sections.note_zh: 商标归各自所有者，遵守品牌的使用规则。
sections.note_en: Trademarks remain with their owners; follow each brand's usage rules.

sections.note_zh: 自绘图标或制定图标集规范前，先读一篇。
sections.note_en: Read one before drawing a custom icon or writing the rules for a set.

sections.note_zh: 画廊看惯例，工具做打包；平台规格会过期。
sections.note_en: Galleries for the idiom, tools for the packaging. Platform specs are perishable.

sections.note_zh: 优化、按数值编辑路径、转换、描摹。
sections.note_en: Optimise, edit paths numerically, convert, trace.

domains.blurb_zh: 插画、3D、摄影、样机与代码生成的背景
domains.blurb_en: Illustrations, 3D, photography, mock-ups, and code-native backgrounds. Licence mistakes are the main risk in this domain: the Access column states the licence reality for each source.

sections.note_zh: 一个产品只用一套风格；流传广的免费套装一眼被认出，重绘或少用。
sections.note_en: One style per product. Widely used free sets are instantly recognisable; restyle or use sparingly.

sections.note_zh: 模型、材质与场景。嵌入前先算运行时代价。
sections.note_en: Models, materials and scenes. Check the runtime cost before embedding.

sections.note_zh: 统一处理图片气质；绝不用网上搜来的无授权图。
sections.note_en: Treat images consistently. Never use unlicensed images found online.

sections.note_zh: 干净的边框通常比摆拍场景更能呈现界面。
sections.note_en: Clean frames usually present UI better than staged scenes.

sections.note_zh: 多数用代码重做更可控；渐变按感知空间插值，加噪点防色带。
sections.note_en: Often better recreated in code for control. Interpolate gradients perceptually and add grain against banding.

domains.blurb_zh: logo 档案、品牌评审、规范手册与命名工具
domains.blurb_en: Archives to see how a form has already been solved, publications that critique identity work, real guideline documents, studio case studies, and the tools for naming and trademark checks.

sections.note_zh: 动手画之前先按首字母、形状和行业查重；与现有标志相似是法律风险。
sections.note_en: Search the client's initial, shape family and industry before sketching. Similarity to an existing mark is a legal risk, not only a taste issue.

sections.note_zh: 学品牌评论的词汇，看识别系统如何延伸到 logo 之外。
sections.note_en: Learn the vocabulary of identity critique and how systems extend beyond the logo.

sections.note_zh: 写规范前，打开三份同行业的规范对照目录。
sections.note_en: Open three guidelines from a similar industry and compare their contents before writing one.

sections.note_zh: 看问题如何被框定、作品如何被放在应用场景里呈现。
sections.note_en: Read how the problem is framed and how the work is presented in application.

sections.note_zh: 这些工具排查明显冲突；正式注册仍需专业检索。
sections.note_en: An agent cannot clear a mark. These tools find obvious conflicts; a professional search is still required.

domains.blurb_zh: 海报、设计史档案、演示文稿与平面出版物
domains.blurb_en: Posters, archives, decks, covers, packaging and the publications that track contemporary graphic design. The strongest moves available to a code-based designer are typographic, so typographic posters and historical archives are the richest sources.

sections.note_zh: 研究网格、尺度对比，以及页面上东西可以少到什么程度。
sections.note_en: Study grid, scale contrast and how little is on the page.

sections.note_zh: 要真实的时代参照，不要仿古拼贴。
sections.note_en: Authentic period references instead of pastiche.

sections.note_zh: 先叙事顺序，后版式系统。
sections.note_en: Narrative order first, slide system second.

sections.note_zh: 固定画框下的单一概念构图。
sections.note_en: Single-idea composition under a fixed frame.

sections.note_zh: 界面设计之外的美术指导意识。
sections.note_en: Art-direction awareness beyond interface design.

sections.note_zh: 尺寸会过期：导出前以平台当前页面为准。
sections.note_en: Sizes are perishable: verify with the platform before export.

domains.blurb_zh: 开源字体、厂商、用例、工具与中日韩字体排版
domains.blurb_en: Open font sources with clear licences, commercial foundries worth knowing, type seen in real use, tools, the guides that matter, and a full section for CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) type and typesetting.

sections.note_zh: 避开默认字体又没有授权风险的路；自托管，别热链。
sections.note_en: The route away from default typefaces without licence risk. Self-host; do not hot-link.

sections.note_zh: 试用文件只能用于样稿，不能随产品发布。
sections.note_en: Trial and free-to-try files are for mock-ups only and must not ship.

sections.note_zh: 选定字体前，先看它在真实语境里的样子。
sections.note_en: See a typeface set in real context before choosing it.

sections.note_zh: 字阶、流式字号、系统字体栈、检测、度量与子集化。
sections.note_en: Scales, fluid type, system stacks, inspection, metrics and subsetting.

sections.note_zh: 前两篇值得完整读一遍。
sections.note_en: Read the first two in full once.

sections.en: CJK type and typesetting (Chinese, Japanese, Korean)
sections.note_zh: 开源的中日韩字体、授权目录、网页字体切片，以及标点、断行与中西文混排规则；中文商业字体授权执行严格。
sections.note_en: Open-licence Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts, licence directories, web-font slicing, and the typesetting rules for punctuation, line breaking and mixed scripts. Commercial CJK font licensing is actively enforced.

domains.blurb_zh: 色板灵感、感知均匀色阶工具与对比度校验
domains.blurb_en: Palette inspiration, tools that build perceptually even and accessible scales, contrast and colour-vision checks, and the articles that explain why. Compute contrast; never estimate it.

sections.note_zh: 找气质和起点；没定义角色与对比度之前，色板不是系统。
sections.note_en: For mood and starting points. A palette is not a system until roles and contrast are defined.

sections.note_zh: 在感知空间里生成色阶，把梯级映射到角色。
sections.note_en: Generate scales in a perceptual space; map steps to roles.

sections.note_zh: WCAG 2 比值是法定底线。APCA 是独立提案，并不在 WCAG 3 草案里（WCAG 3 的对比度算法尚未确定）。对比度用算的，不用估的。
sections.note_en: WCAG 2 ratios are the legal baseline. APCA is an independent proposal, not part of the WCAG 3 drafts, whose contrast method is still undecided. Compute contrast; never estimate it.

sections.note_zh: 现代界面色彩系统与暗色模式背后的推理。
sections.note_en: The reasoning behind modern UI colour systems and dark mode.

domains.blurb_zh: agent 的画笔：组件库、动效与图形库、token 工具与渲染管线
domains.blurb_en: The agent's design medium is code. Component libraries and primitives by stack, animation and graphics libraries, token tooling, and the pipeline that turns HTML, SVG and markup into images, PDFs and slides. Verify APIs against the installed version.

sections.note_zh: 优先用宿主项目已有的库；选型时偏好可访问的原语与真正的主题 API。
sections.note_en: Use the host project's library. When choosing, prefer accessible primitives and a real theme API.

sections.note_zh: 技术参考。整套拼装的页面长得都一样：只取一个标志性时刻并重写它。
sections.note_en: Technique references. A page assembled from these looks like every other; use one signature moment and restyle it.

sections.note_zh: 按任务选工具；商用查授权。
sections.note_en: Match the tool to the job; check licences for commercial use.

sections.note_zh: 一份 token 源，构建到所有平台。
sections.note_en: One token source, built to every platform.

sections.note_zh: 代码做的图如何变成 PNG、SVG、PDF、PPTX，字体如何子集化。
sections.note_en: How code-made graphics become PNG, SVG, PDF and PPTX, and how fonts are subset.

sections.note_zh: 可脚本化或开源的工具，补代码优先的工作流。
sections.note_en: Scriptable or open tools that complement a code-first workflow.

sections.note_zh: 用来发现的面；质量自己判断。
sections.note_en: Breadth for discovery. Judge quality yourself.

domains.blurb_zh: 塑造这套方法的文章、书、课程与规范
domains.blurb_en: The articles, books, courses and guidelines whose ideas shape this suite. Prefer primary, durable sources; name the principle when justifying a decision.

sections.note_zh: 让界面"感觉对"的细节，以及结实的 CSS 思维。
sections.note_en: The details that make interfaces feel right, and robust CSS thinking.

sections.zh: 与 AI 一起做设计
sections.note_zh: 为什么模型产出平庸设计，什么能改变这一点。
sections.note_en: Why models produce generic design and what changes that; design in AI-era products.

sections.note_zh: 层级、间距、感知；从前三篇开始。
sections.note_en: Hierarchy, spacing, perception. Start with the first three.

sections.zh: 有研究背书的 UX 指引
sections.note_zh: 引证据，别引观点。
sections.note_en: Evidence to cite instead of opinion.

sections.note_zh: brief、评审格式，以及向相关方解释决策。
sections.note_en: Briefs, critique formats, and explaining decisions to stakeholders.

sections.note_zh: 正典；除注明外都是付费。
sections.note_en: The canon. Paid unless noted.

sections.note_zh: 为建立真本事，值这个价。
sections.note_en: Worth their price for building real skill.

sections.note_zh: 本土案例与团队博客，面向中文市场语境。
sections.note_en: Domestic case studies and team blogs for Chinese-market context.

domains.blurb_zh: 跨学科浏览与收集：量大信号杂，取用后用真实产品验证
domains.blurb_en: Cross-discipline sources for scanning and collecting. High volume, mixed signal: concept shots ignore real content, states and accessibility. Use for visual treatment and trend awareness, then verify against real products.

sections.note_zh: 读案例的过程，不只看封面。
sections.note_en: Read case-study process, not just covers.

sections.note_zh: 从界面设计圈之外收集。
sections.note_en: Collect from outside the interface-design bubble.

sections.note_zh: 趋势雷达；取用要标注日期，潮流会过期。
sections.note_en: Trend radar. Date what you take; fashion expires.

sections.note_zh: 本土作品集、灵感板与共享设计文件。
sections.note_en: Domestic portfolios, moodboards and shared design files.

kinds.note_zh: 精选的成品案例，用来浏览找参考。
kinds.note_en: Curated examples of finished work, browsed for reference.

kinds.note_zh: 按模式整理的真实产品界面与流程，用来查惯例。
kinds.note_en: Real-product screens or flows organised by pattern, for checking conventions.

kinds.note_zh: 某个组织公开的设计系统：token、组件与使用指引。
kinds.note_en: One organisation's published design system: tokens, components and guidance.

kinds.note_zh: 平台或从业者给出的规则与建议；权威，但不是正式标准。
kinds.note_en: Rules and advice from a platform or practitioner; authoritative but not a formal standard.

kinds.note_zh: 规范性标准或文件格式规格，如 WCAG、DTCG、DESIGN.md。
kinds.note_en: A normative standard or file-format specification, such as WCAG, DTCG or DESIGN.md.

kinds.note_zh: 需要人来操作的交互工具：取色、编辑、检测、转换。
kinds.note_en: An interactive utility you operate: picker, editor, checker, converter.

kinds.note_zh: 从提示词直接生成界面、设计或图像：你描述，它产出。
kinds.note_en: Produces a UI, design or image from a prompt: you describe, it makes.

kinds.note_zh: 安装后在代码里调用的库（npm、pip、Swift、Kotlin 等）。
kinds.note_en: Code you install and call (npm, pip, Swift, Kotlin and so on).

kinds.note_zh: 单个字体或超级字族。
kinds.note_en: One typeface or superfamily.

kinds.note_zh: 众多字体的来源：字体厂商、市场、开源字体服务或授权目录。
kinds.note_en: A source of many fonts: foundry, marketplace, open-font service or licence directory.

kinds.note_zh: 风格统一的一套图标。
kinds.note_en: One icon family with a consistent style.

kinds.note_zh: 汇集多位作者作品的素材库：插画、照片、3D、动画、图标。
kinds.note_en: Assets from many authors: illustration, photo, 3D, animation, icons.

kinds.note_zh: 单篇文章或随笔，或持续更新的博客与刊物。
kinds.note_en: An article or essay, or a blog or publication that keeps publishing them.

kinds.note_zh: 书；除注明外为付费。
kinds.note_en: A book; paid unless noted.

kinds.note_zh: 成体系的课程。
